task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence through three bounded tasks: restore automatic attack audio causality, repair authored presentation while shipping the required upgrade-choice and arena-spatial capabilities, and qualify dense-wave performance for host recapture.

diagnosis.root_cause: The automatic lantern transaction still lacks a reliably bound anticipation source reaching the Effects bus, and runtime-visible Warden/cemetery meshes still report degenerate UV surfaces. The deferred camera issue is excluded from current implementation scope.

stop_conditions: Preserve the accepted CemeteryGarden and Warden packages, AttackRuntime exactly-once receipts, deterministic targeting, and Warden onset/impact/recovery mappings.
Do not perform a separate camera-transform treatment for finding.camera_occlusion.
Stop each task when its stated implementation and direct Tester retest conditions are satisfied.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause approach for the twice-treated audio issue: restore the authored audio-library binding and explicit attack-event adapter rather than repeating transform tuning. Assign the untreated mesh defect to the authored presentation task, which also fulfills the mandatory choice visual hierarchy and arena spatial capabilities, and isolate dense profiling in the third task.

code: Run parser/static checks and focused tests for attack-event deduplication, choice formatting/focus/debounce, collision bindings, mesh validation, and dense lifecycle counters.
Verify preserved authored hierarchies remain intact and tester-only actions are release-guarded or unbound.
runtime: Tester/host recapture gap:release_convergence_automatic_combat_causality_contract with a fresh Effects capture showing one non-silent four-stage attack sequence and exactly-once receipts.
Tester/host recapture gap:release_convergence_animation_vfx_lighting_audio_contract with mesh validation and shipped-camera attack/cemetery frames, including the upgrade draft and spatial traversal.
Tester/host replay the representative dense wave at 1920x1080 and verify frame-time, entity, callback, memory, and audio-voice bounds.
visual: Capture the upgrade draft showing silhouettes/icons, truthful current-to-new deltas, restrained hierarchy, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.

Capture spawn, central building/landmark, external world/external depth, and perimeter/boundary during ordinary movement/movement replay; confirm collision alignment and no disappearance/occlusion drift.
Capture automatic attack anticipation/onset/impact/recovery and dense cemetery composition under the existing moonlight/lantern lighting hierarchy without placeholders.

done_when: Each ordinary automatic Warden Lantern attack emits exactly one recognizable bounded anticipation, onset, impact, and recovery sequence on the Effects bus; the capture is non-silent and has matching source events.
AttackRuntime authorization, hit, death, and drop receipts remain exactly once per transaction with deterministic target selection, and generic shot VFX does not replay the complete attack report.
A same-session black-box replay plus source inspection can correlate the audio timeline to the authoritative attack receipt without missing-source or duplicate-source events.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned automatic lantern feedback path by binding a non-silent anticipation source in the authored audio library and routing explicit attack events through the Effects bus. Preserve the existing onset/impact/recovery source mappings and AttackRuntime authority; use bounded source IDs, voice limits, and deduplication so one attack produces one transient. This is an event/binding repair, not another transform-tuning treatment.
tasks.title: Restore automatic lantern attack audio causality

done_when: Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with a visual hierarchy led by authored weapon or upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, and restrained copy.

Every choice shows truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas; CURRENT never contains NEW or LOCKED placeholders, and unchanged or exhaustive rows are omitted.
Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, and selected states are visibly distinct; held confirm is debounced and the selected upgrade applies before gameplay resumes.

The arena has expand/larger traversable scale, coherent external world/external depth, and a stable central building/landmark. Visible geometry agrees with collision during ordinary movement/movement replay; there is no disappearance or occlusion drift, and the perimeter/boundary remains stable.
Mesh validation reports zero degenerate UV surfaces for runtime-visible Warden and cemetery meshes without destructive asset surgery or replacement of the preserved authored packages.
tasks.instructions: At the owning scene/material boundaries, repair degenerate UV data while retaining the intact CemeteryGarden/Warden hierarchy. Implement the upgrade draft as a bespoke choice interface: replace text-stacked choices with silhouettes/icons, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant deltas, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states. Provide larger traversable scale with coherent external world depth; keep the central building/landmark aligned to collision and visible under ordinary movement/movement replay, with no disappearance/occlusion drift at the perimeter/boundary. Validate shipped framing without retuning the deferred camera defect.
tasks.title: Repair authored meshes and ship truthful choice/spatial presentation

done_when: The representative final-wave scenario at 1920x1080 sustains the designated 60-FPS target with 25–40 ordinary enemies, three weapon families, pickups, UI, VFX, lights, and boss behavior.

Frame-time distribution and active enemy, projectile, pickup, impact, particle, dynamic-light, and audio-voice counts remain bounded across wave progression and repeated replay, with no recurring runtime errors or unbounded node, callback, memory, or voice growth.
Candidate-owned diagnostics expose deterministic frame/entity lifecycle metrics without changing shipped HUD semantics; tester-only preparation/advance actions are release-build guarded.
A stable dense-wave replay is available for host to recapture the performance contract and verify instrumentation does not alter authoritative gameplay truth.
tasks.instructions: Profile the real dense-wave scenario rather than an empty arena, then bound high-churn entity, effect, light, physics-query, and audio lifecycles using the existing director and actor architecture. Add deterministic frame-time and active-count diagnostics for host collection, keep tester-only setup/advance hooks unavailable in release exports, and preserve authoritative combat, upgrade, and map behavior.
tasks.title: Qualify dense-wave performance and lifecycle bounds
